citations.quote: Granite Shield does not refresh its cooldown from damage that is mitigated by shields.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Damage absorbed by shields does not restart Granite Shield's recharge cooldown.

citations.quote: The shield lasts until it is broken, and replenishes to full strength after a few seconds of not taking damage.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The shield persists until broken and recharges to full strength.

citations.quote: Malphite gains increased percentage size equal to 8% of his total armor, capped at 35% increased size at 437.5 armor.
His increased size does not consider Thunderclap's bonus armor.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Armor increases Malphite's size up to a cap; Thunderclap's bonus armor does not contribute to this size increase.

citations.quote: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health.
Malphite grants himself a shield equal to 10% of his maximum health.

core_mechanics.summary: Passively gains a damage-absorbing shield based on maximum health.

citations.quote: If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.
which refreshes after a few seconds without taking damage.

core_mechanics.summary: The shield recharges after a period without taking damage, subject to the shield-absorbed damage exception.

unsupported_claims: Every hit restarts shield recharge, including damage fully absorbed by shields.
The shield grants invulnerability or crowd-control immunity.

citations.quote: Malphite also gains bonus movement speed equal to the raw amount of movement speed the target lost from the slow for the duration.
Slow-resistant and slow-immune targets will reduce or nullify Malphite's gain.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The movement-speed gain depends on the target's raw speed loss; slow resistance or immunity can reduce or eliminate it.

citations.quote: Seismic Shard's movement speed gain is based off the target's movement speed raw total movement speed lost at the time of impact.
Malphite will gain the bonus movement speed for the full duration as long as Seismic Shard impacts the target.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The speed gain is determined at impact and lasts its full duration when the shard impacts.

citations.quote: If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).

advanced_exceptions.summary: Specified target eligibility failures during the cast cancel the ability without spending its cost or starting its cooldown.

citations.quote: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact
Malphite sends a shard to the target enemy that deals magic damage

core_mechanics.summary: Sends a targeted shard that deals magic damage on impact.

citations.quote: stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
slows them for a few seconds. He also gains bonus movement speed for the same duration.

core_mechanics.summary: Temporarily slows the target and grants Malphite movement speed, with the gain depending on the speed actually lost.

unsupported_claims: Malphite gains the same movement speed regardless of the target's slow resistance or immunity.
The shard damages or slows an area around its target.

citations.quote: Thunderclap resets Malphite's basic attack timer.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Activation resets the basic attack timer.

citations.quote: Thunderclap deals 180% damage against monsters.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Thunderclap deals increased damage against monsters.

citations.quote: Benefits from Thunderclap's cone effect.
Unlike similar spells, it does not deal its damage separately to the primary target of the attack(s); if the target is outside the area of effect when struck, it will not take the additional damage.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The initial empowered attack also triggers the cone; the primary target receives cone damage only if inside its area when struck.

citations.quote: Prevents Malphite from casting Seismic Shard and Ground Slam during its windup.
Cannot have its windup canceled by new movement or attack commands, or casting Unstoppable Force.
Can have its windup canceled by casting Hextech Rocketbelt.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The empowered attack's windup restricts Q and E casting and resists specified cancellation inputs, but Hextech Rocketbelt can cancel it.

citations.quote: Passive: Malphite gains bonus armor, tripled while Granite Shield is active.

core_mechanics.summary: Passively grants bonus armor, with that bonus tripled while Granite Shield is active.

citations.quote: Malphite's next basic attack within a few seconds is empowered to gain bonus range and deal additional physical damage.

core_mechanics.summary: Activation empowers the next basic attack with extra range and additional physical damage.

citations.quote: For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.
Malphite's basic attacks for the next few seconds trigger a cone in the direction of the target that deals physical damage to enemies hit.

core_mechanics.summary: For a short duration, basic attacks trigger a forward cone of physical damage.

unsupported_claims: Granite Shield triples Malphite's total armor.
Cone damage always hits the primary attack target regardless of its position.
The empowered attack's windup cannot be canceled by any means.

citations.quote: The cripple stacks multiplicatively with other sources of attack speed reductions.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The attack-speed reduction stacks multiplicatively with other attack-speed reductions.

citations.quote: This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The effect originates from Malphite's position at the end of the cast time.

citations.quote: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor
Malphite slams the ground beneath him, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies

core_mechanics.summary: Deals magic damage to nearby enemies around Malphite; the damage scales with armor.

citations.quote: reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
crippling them for 3 seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: Temporarily reduces affected enemies' attack speed.

unsupported_claims: Multiple Ground Slams stack their attack-speed reductions in standard play; the supplied stacking statement is limited to One for All.
